text: {"question": "What percentage of patients typically experience gastrointestinal adverse events from GLP-1 and dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonists?", "answer": "Gastrointestinal adverse effects, such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and constipation, typically occur in about 30% to 50% of patients, mostly during the initiation and dose escalation phases.", "evidence": "Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and constipation are established class effects, occurring in approximately 30%-50% of patients, typically during initiation and dose escalation."}
